structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page only lists kinds of saving with a line or two on each, and I never got to read the deposit card. I'll ask my son, or the bank, whether something as safe as my deposits pays more and what the bank takes.

stuck.why: The cards for חשבון עובר ושב, פיקדון and תכנית חיסכון were cut off. On the next screen I only saw their last words, so I never read the deposit card, which is the one thing I came for.
'כסף שצריך להישאר זמין' sounded like me, but it points to 'קרן כספית', which I don't know, so I didn't click it.
I know government bonds are safe, but 'צמודה' and 'לא צמודה' left me not knowing which is which.
English letters (MSCI, S&P) and many 'מדד' cards. I felt it wasn't for me and was tired.
